keySentence: The hunter came and saved her.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: The hunter was brave. He stopped the wolf. He found Grandmother. The hunter came and saved her.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: The hunter stood between the wolf and Red Riding Hood. The wolf tried to run but the hunter was too strong. The hunter came and saved her from the dangerous wolf. He searched the house and found Grandmother in the closet. She was scared but safe and sound. Red Riding Hood hugged Grandmother and cried with joy.
